# Which of your clients actually pay you well per hour?

> Free analyzer for freelancers, consultants and agencies: load a time export from Toggl, Clockify, Harvest or a spreadsheet and see each client's effective hourly rate against your target, unbilled time, flat-fee scope creep and which clients to reprice. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
